title: build_lookup_request is exposed @internal for tests but has no unit test (asymmetric with build_send_request)
detail: build_lookup_request (GET method, Basic auth header, %2B-encoded URL) is untested, while its SMS twin build_send_request has two tests. In-scope pure-builder coverage sits at the CONCERNS boundary (~90%).
recommended_fix: Add a build_lookup_request test asserting GET, the Basic auth header, and the %2B-encoded URL (mirror the build_send_request tests).

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
evidence: sms_client_test.gleam covers build_send_form_body, build_messages_url, status_callback_url, basic_auth_header, parse_send_response, send_sms(Disabled), build_send_request; lookup_test.gleam covers parse_line_type, build_lookup_url, lookup_line_type(Disabled), voip. do_send/do_lookup dispatch envelopes have no test.
detail: In-scope pure builders/parse/no-op ~90% (one gap: build_lookup_request). The HTTP dispatch envelopes (do_send/do_lookup) and their error branches are 0% covered at unit and integration level; spec defers them to integration, but no caller is wired this story.
recommended_fix: Add the build_lookup_request test now; cover do_send/do_lookup failure paths via integration tests when rc3-5/rc3-7 wire callers.
